component.name: lazysite
component.description: TAPPaaS module lazysite: generated from lazysite-components.json; do not edit.

analysis.detail: lazysite/nix:libxslt. libxslt is only linked into nginx's built-in xslt filter, and the lazysite nginx.conf has no xslt_stylesheet directive, so no XSLT is ever run; the libxml2 it links (2.15.4) also carries the upstream mitigation (>= 2.14.5). Decided by migration 2026-11-12; review by 2027-05-11.
